_doc: Phase 91.S3 BLIND validation set. Authored in one pass and SEALED by the commit that introduces it; run once per arm against a FROZEN baseline and a FROZEN candidate, with the criteria below fixed before any answer is seen. Nothing here reuses a value, a name, a phrasing or a failure already seen in conv_v1, conv_v2, learn_v1 or learn_r1 — those are regression/DEV from now on and are never a blind test again. Eight families, six conversations each, PT and EN, every one teaching in three turns and asking in a NEW session with a paraphrase that never repeats the teaching wording. `expected_ledger` uses EXACT value matching (the default since 91.V4; this file declares no prefix). `abstain` marks the cases where refusing is the correct answer. `tense` says whether the question asks about the present. All values are synthetic and none belongs to the user.
